KEN.note: AI is named only inside tax and customs, a sector system, not general administration.

facts.fact: President Ruto said Kenya Revenue Authority's Customs Department piloted AI-powered risk engines, followed by its highest-ever monthly customs revenue of KSh 85 billion.
President Ruto said Kenya is among the earliest Sub-Saharan countries to have integrated AI-powered risk engines into tax compliance at KRA.
President Ruto said AI-powered risk engines were piloted in KRA's Customs Department alongside re-engineering of its processes.

KEN.note: Filing by USSD and WhatsApp is stated, but no electronic payment of tax is stated.

facts.fact: KRA Commissioner General Humphrey Wattanga said a Kenyan can file returns through the USSD code *222*5# and KRA services are also on WhatsApp.
